changeSet.sql:
create or alter procedure api.DeleteExecutionRecords @numberOfDaysOlderThan int = 30 as
begin BEGIN TRANSACTION; SAVE TRANSACTION ApiDeleteSavePoint;
BEGIN TRY -- delete records from child tables delete from api.ExecutionAsset where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionAssetCrossReference where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionAssetError where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionAssetResult where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeleteAssetResult where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeletedAsset where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeletedAssetType where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeletedGroup where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeletedPredicate where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeletedRelationship where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDeletedRelationshipType where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDiagramAsset where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionDiagramAssetField where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionField where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionGroup where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionMetric where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionMetricMeasure where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionPredicate where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionRelationship where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionRelationshipError where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionRelationshipType where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionResponsibilityRule where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan) delete from api.ExecutionResponsibilityType where executionid in (select ExecutionID from api.Execution e where DATEDIFF(day, e.CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan)
-- finally delete the api.execution records themselves delete from api.Execution where DATEDIFF(day, CompletedOn, getutcdate()) > @numberOfDaysOlderThan
COMMIT TRANSACTION END TRY BEGIN CATCH IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 BEGIN ROLLBACK TRANSACTION ApiDeleteSavePoint; -- rollback to MySavePoint END END CATCH end
